text: Gemini's right on the rate sensitivity — auto and battery names like Tata Motors or Exide will swing hard on the RBI's next move, but ICICI Bank's 16% revenue growth and 19.2% decade CAGR show why quality financials compound through cycles. speaker: Kimi K3
text: Union Bank's 36% five-year CAGR looks spectacular until you see the 93% max drawdown — that's a near-death experience for shareholders, and the stock is still 37% off its highs despite a 28% one-year run. The quarterly numbers show steady progress: revenue climbing from Rs 1.46T to Rs 1.59T and net income from Rs 50.7B to Rs 57.8B over the last year, with three straight 20%+ earnings surprises. But the beta of 1.27 means it amplifies every Nifty downdraft, and those post-earnings moves (+5.3%, -1.1%, -8.8%, +7.9%) are all over the place. At 5.3% dividend yield you're getting paid to wait, but the 17 analysts are split 11 buy vs 6 hold/sell — no consensus conviction. For your Rs 10,000, you'd get about 43 shares at Rs 232, but the 0.38% round-trip cost on Zerodha delivery means you need Rs 38 just to break even.

As for NVDA, a $10 fractional share at today’s price would be about 0.02 shares; holding for a year could give you roughly a 25 % gain before taxes, but the spread and any short‑term tax would eat a chunk of that.
